name: kanaa-test-bot
description: Automated testing bot for the Kanaa e-commerce site (dev-nx.thekanaa.com)

scripts.discover:homepage: npm run discover:homepage:en && npm run discover:homepage:ar
scripts.plan:homepage: npm run plan:homepage:en && npm run plan:homepage:ar
scripts.test:homepage:en: cross-env HOMEPAGE_LOCALE=en playwright test --config=playwright.homepage.config.js tests/homepage --project=chromium --grep-invert "Cross-browser homepage smoke"
scripts.test:homepage:ar: cross-env HOMEPAGE_LOCALE=ar playwright test --config=playwright.homepage.config.js tests/homepage --project=chromium --grep-invert "Cross-browser homepage smoke"
scripts.test:homepage: npm run test:homepage:en && npm run test:homepage:ar
scripts.test:homepage:browsers: npm run test:homepage:browsers:en && npm run test:homepage:browsers:ar
scripts.bugs:homepage: npm run bugs:homepage:en && npm run bugs:homepage:ar
scripts.report:homepage: npm run report:homepage:en && npm run report:homepage:ar && node scripts/generate-combined-report.js
